observation: Native standalone enemy99, graze trail and cancellation roots are interleaved by registration. Web updates all enemy roots before the independent visual pass, causing cancellation to sample a different loop delay.
candidate: Use a shared registration sequence for delayed graze roots; advance older independent roots before the next enemy animation root, guarded against duplicate updates.

candidateResult.action: Reverted broad root interleaving. Native enemy99/104 are created through detached paths, so root-level registration does not express child creation order.

early1686.observation: Native existing attached enemy roots finish before the cancellation emitter. Sorting parent root registrations is insufficient because script99/104 children use detached initialization paths.

queueObservation: 106 roots have native flags2 and early manager indices. 103 roots have flags0 and are interleaved with independent cancellation roots. Restrict candidate interleaving to enemy103 roots.
